subject: txn, planner: Fix the problem that with pessimistic-auto-commit enabled, some internal transactions may try to commit transaction with MaxUint64 (#62881)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on planner/executor/sessionctx changes. The update makes `SessionVars.PessimisticLockEligible()` reject `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` in autocommit (while keeping DML eligible) and adjusts `eliminateUnionScanAndLock` to always drop `PhysicalLock`/`UnionScan` for PointGet/BatchPointGet when lock is ineligible, aligning plan/explain with runtime behavior and avoiding MaxUint64-startTS + lock/commit paths for internal/autocommit point-gets. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, transaction/session, or planner/executor issues found in the touched areas.
